verses.t: (_Miss Angelica has challenged Mr. Wotherspoon to a race on the Queen's highway._)

Mr. W. Going strong!
Come along!

Miss A. Road quite even!
Perfect heaven!

Mr. W. Goal in view!
Running true!

Miss A. Make it faster!
Spur your caster!
Illustration: Motor Fiend. "Why don't you get out of the way?"
